ShareToken 是开源权重模型的 P2P 共享网络。闲时共享算力赚 cre: ShareToken is a P2P sharing network for open-weight models. Share idle compute to earn credit, and call other people's nodes over the OpenAI protocol when you need them. Requests are end-to-end encrypted, responses carry signed receipts, and overstated usage is refunded on evidence.
一单一钥：拿证据退款，只暴露这一单: One job, one key: get a refund with evidence, exposing only that job
不在数据路径上。只有你发起争议并主动交出密钥时，才能解开那一单: Not on the data path. It can open a job only if you start a dispute and hand over that job's key
不靠信任平台，靠密码学。: Rely on cryptography, not on trusting a platform.
严格 CSP，无第三方资源。会话放在 HttpOnly + SameSite=S: Strict CSP and no third-party assets. Sessions live in HttpOnly + SameSite=Strict cookies.

买家和卖家在同一个进程里。自动测 RTT，选最快的中继，中继故障时自动切换。: Buyer and seller run in the same process. It measures RTT, picks the fastest relay and switches automatically when a relay fails.

加密把信任边界移到了节点，只有 TEE 才能把运营者也排除在外。敏感内容请选 T: Encryption moves the trust boundary to the node. Only a TEE also shuts out the operator. Choose TEE nodes for sensitive content.
协调器仍然是账本的可信方。: The coordinator is still the trusted party for the ledger.
协调器以新身份随机下单，在参考模型上重算比对。连续两次不符，暂停接单 24 小时: The coordinator places random orders under fresh identities and compares the results on a reference model. Two mismatches in a row suspend the node for 24 hours.
协调器负责撮合和记账，不在这条路径上: The coordinator handles matching and accounting, and is not on this path
反过来，买家也赖不掉：有效的 Ack 可以直接结算，无 Ack 的单子过了 24: Buyers can't back out either: a valid Ack settles directly, and a job with no Ack is final once the 24-hour dispute window closes.
只转发密文，不记账: Forwards ciphertext only, keeps no accounts
同一个账户，既能卖也能买。: One account to both sell and buy.
哈希一致 → 买家签 Ack，作业结算: Hashes match → the buyer signs an Ack and the job settles
哈希不一致 → 买家拒签，可凭证据发起争议: Hashes differ → the buyer refuses to sign and can dispute with evidence
它伪造不了收据和 Ack，但账本由它记录。: It cannot forge receipts or Acks, but it is the one keeping the ledger.
它让作弊长期不划算，但不保证每一单都被查到。: They make cheating unprofitable over time, but do not guarantee that every job gets checked.
客户端在本地开一个 OpenAI 兼容端点。任何支持 OpenAI 协议的工具，: The client opens a local OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Any tool that speaks the OpenAI protocol works once you change its base URL.
每次用发到邮箱的验证码登录，没有密码可被撞库或泄露。验证码和登录失败都限流。人人: You sign in each time with a code sent to your email, so there is no password to stuff or leak. Codes and failed sign-ins are rate limited. Anyone can turn on TOTP two-factor authentication; admins must.

开源权重模型的 P2P 共享网络: A P2P sharing network for open-weight models
开源权重模型的 P2P 共享网络：端到端加密、签名收据、证据裁决。: A P2P sharing network for open-weight models: end-to-end encryption, signed receipts, evidence-based disputes.
把本机 Ollama 里的模型共享出去。不需要公网 IP，节点经中继打通连接。: Share a model from your local Ollama. No public IP needed: nodes connect through relays.
把机器上的模型接入网络，闲时赚 credit，要用时按 OpenAI 协议调用别: Connect the models on your machine to the network and earn credit while idle. When you need compute, call other people's nodes over the OpenAI protocol. Only the target node can open a request, and every response carries the node's signature.
撮合、结算、争议和抽检。不监听任何端口，只能经中继访问，暴露面很小。: Matching, settlement, disputes and audits. It listens on no ports and is reachable only through relays, so its exposure is small.
收件钥只存在于机密虚拟机内，节点运营者也读不到内存: The recipient key exists only inside the confidential VM, and even the node operator cannot read its memory
有多个，只转发加密流量。读不到明文，不记账，只给持有效凭证的设备预约。: There are several, and they forward only encrypted traffic. They cannot read plaintext, keep no accounts, and accept reservations only from devices with a valid pass.
核对收据里的两个哈希: Check the two hashes in the receipt
每条消息都生成新的临时密钥，用节点在签名 Offer 里公布的公钥协商出一次性的: Each message generates a new ephemeral key and uses the public key the node published in its signed Offer to agree on a one-time symmetric key. Ciphertext is also bound to the job ID and sequence number, so it cannot be replayed into another job or reordered in a stream.
注册登录、API token、设备绑定、账单和中继登记，就是你现在看到的这个网站: Sign-up and login, API tokens, device binding, bills and relay registration. It's the website you're looking at now.
演示：一组作业中只有发生争议的一单被解开，裁决方重新计数后退款，其它作业保持加密: Demo: in a set of jobs, only the disputed job is opened. The arbiter recounts and refunds, and all other jobs stay encrypted.
演示：买家的 prompt 加密后经过中继，中继只能看到密文，到达目标节点后才被: Demo: the buyer's prompt is encrypted and passes through a relay that sees only ciphertext. It is decrypted only on reaching the target node. The coordinator is not on the data path.
点下面任意一块响应，亲手篡改它。哈希是浏览器现场用 SHA-256 算的。: Click any response chunk below to tamper with it yourself. Your browser computes the hash live with SHA-256.
签名收据：改一个字，整份作废: Signed receipts: change one character and the whole receipt is void
网络里的每一方都是一个 Ed25519 身份。谁发了什么、签了什么，都可以离线验: Every party on the network is an Ed25519 identity. Who sent and signed what can be verified offline.
节点用 Ed25519 签下请求和响应的哈希、模型和用量。买家不看节点怎么说，自: The node uses Ed25519 to sign the request and response hashes, the model and the usage. The buyer doesn't take the node's word for it and recomputes what it received. A node that signs one thing and delivers another is caught on the spot.
节点虚报用量时，买家拒签，并交出<strong>这一单</strong>的密钥作: When a node overstates usage, the buyer refuses to sign and hands over the key of this one job as evidence. The arbiter checks the receipt, decrypts the response, recounts the tokens with a reference model and rules automatically. Every other job has its own key, and nobody can open those.
解密响应，用参考模型重新计数: Decrypt the response and recount with a reference model
计费按 Ticket 上的价格结算，不超过预留金额。复式账本启动时回放日志对账。: Billing settles at the Ticket's price and never exceeds the reserved amount. The double-entry ledger replays its log to reconcile at startup.
中继节点分布在北美、欧洲和亚洲: Relay nodes in North America, Europe and Asia
转发流量的看不到内容，记账的不碰数据路径，管账户的不撮合交易。: Whoever forwards traffic can't see content, whoever keeps accounts stays off the data path, and whoever manages accounts doesn't match trades.
运行模型就必须解密，运营者理论上能读到: Running a model requires decryption, so the operator can in principle read it

门户签发 1 小时有效的 Ed25519 凭证，写明设备 peer ID。凭证被: The portal issues Ed25519 passes valid for 1 hour, naming the device's peer ID. A stolen pass is useless.
非流式响应在收据验证通过后才交给你；流式响应边到边转发，结尾附验证结果。: Non-streaming responses reach you only after the receipt verifies. Streaming responses are forwarded as they arrive, with the verification result at the end.

节点不需要公网 IP，经中继打通连接；自动测 RTT 选最快的中继，故障时自动切: Nodes need no public IP and connect through relays. The client measures RTT to pick the fastest relay and switches automatically when one fails.
接入在模型厂商开通的 API key 或订阅服务对外共享，买家可以用 Anthr: Share the API keys or subscriptions you have with model providers. Buyers call them in the Anthropic, OpenAI or Gemini message format or over the OpenAI-compatible protocol.
请求封装加密，只有目标节点打得开，中继和协调器都看不到。: Requests are sealed so that only the target node can open them. Relays and the coordinator cannot see them.
响应带节点的 Ed25519 签名收据，买家自己核对，内容被改动会被发现。: Responses carry the node's Ed25519-signed receipt. Buyers check it themselves, so altered content is detected.
节点虚报用量时，买家只交出这一单的密钥作为证据，裁决后自动退款。: When a node over-reports usage, the buyer hands over the key of that one job as evidence and is refunded automatically after the ruling.
协调器随机抽检，检查节点有没有偷换模型。抽检是概率性的。: The coordinator audits nodes at random to check that they have not swapped the model. Audits are probabilistic.
普通节点的运营者能读到 prompt，需要排除运营者时可以选 TEE 节点（AM: Operators of ordinary nodes can read prompts. To exclude the operator, choose TEE nodes (AMD SEV-SNP / Intel TDX).
卖家生成配对码发给买家；买家配对后只向配对的卖家购买，最多同时配对三个卖家。: A seller creates a pairing code and gives it to buyers. A paired buyer buys only from its paired sellers, up to three at a time.
配对码有效期可选 1 天、7 天或 30 天，可以限制使用人数，随时撤销；买卖双: A pairing code lasts 1, 7 or 30 days, can be limited to a number of buyers and can be revoked at any time. Either side can end a pairing.
私有模式：开启后卖家只为配对的买家服务，其他人看不到它的模型。: Private mode: when it is on, the seller serves only its paired buyers and nobody else sees its models.
桌面应用、命令行和用户页面都能管理配对。: Pairing can be managed in the desktop app, on the command line and on the user page.
